Enterprise Product Manager
Darwinbox
Hyderabad, Telangana, India (Hybrid)

About Darwinbox:
Darwinbox is a leading enterprise HR tech unicorn backed by Salesforce Ventures and Sequoia.

Responsibilities:
• Drive enterprise product roadmap for global payroll and workforce management.
• Partner with Fortune 500 HR leaders for customer discovery and feature prioritization.
• Collaborate with enterprise sales and engineering to deliver custom workflows.

Requirements:
• 4 to 6 years of product management experience in enterprise B2B SaaS.
• Proven track record with complex PRDs, enterprise workflows, and compliance.
• Engineering degree (B.Tech / B.E.) required.
